rationale:
The requirement applies: `assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site.

It meets the obligation. After the front matter and the `# Habeas` title there is a short intro paragraph. The first `##` section is `## Workflow`, and it comes before `## Inspecting`, `## Requirements, examples, and definitions`, `## References` and `## Gotchas`. The intro paragraph sits under the document title and is not a separate section.

The Workflow section is ordered steps: "- [ ] 1. Pick the skill for the task" with a table, then "- [ ] 2. Follow that skill; each one names the next". The numbering makes them ordered.

There were no violation matches to judge.
